name: Auto Deco
description: Pick a style and decorate your whole level: blocks, details, background, colours and pulses synced to the song.

beat-source.name: Beat source
beat-source.description:
Where the pulse timing comes from.
<cy>Auto</c>: the level's guidelines if it has at least 8, otherwise the song is analysed.
<cy>Song</c>: always analyse the song.
<cy>Guidelines</c>: only the level's guidelines.
<cy>Fixed tempo</c>: the tempo and first beat below.
<cy>Off</c>: no pulses.

fixed-bpm.name: Fixed tempo (BPM)
fixed-bpm.description: Used when Beat source is Fixed tempo. Use this too if song analysis picks half the real tempo (common with drum and bass).

deco-group.name: Auto Deco group ID
deco-group.description: Every object Auto Deco adds gets this group, so it can find, replace and remove its own work. Pick a group your level does not use.

channel-base.name: First colour channel
channel-base.description: Auto Deco uses 7 colour channels starting here (fill, outline, glow, details, two background colours and block patterns), plus BG, Ground and Line. Pick channels your level does not use.

color-triggers.name: Colour triggers at the start
color-triggers.description: Also place colour triggers at the start of the level that set the style's colours. The colours are always set as the level's starting colours too; the triggers are a backup.

editor-layer.name: Editor layer
editor-layer.description: Editor layer for everything Auto Deco adds, so you can hide it while editing the layout.

max-objects.name: Object limit per run
max-objects.description: Refuse to decorate if one run would add more objects than this.

auto-orient.name: Detect piece orientation
auto-orient.description: Look at each outline and glow sprite to work out which way it faces before placing it. Leave on unless pieces come out wrong.
